files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed

- **A search that is still being typed in Paperless's advanced syntax no longer shows as a failed search, and a Paperless that hangs no longer makes every search wait twice.** Paperless 3 refuses a query that it can't parse yet, such as `created:[2026 to` while you type the range of dates, and the search showed nothing for it while *Search problems* in the settings filled up with failed searches that were none, pushing real problems out of the list. Now such a search finds the documents of its words in the simple search of Paperless 3, and neither it nor a page past the last result shows up as a problem. A request that waited in vain for a Paperless that accepts connections but doesn't answer, as while it consumes documents or rebuilds its index, was sent a second time, so every keystroke waited 20 seconds and Paperless got every request twice; now only a request that never reached Paperless is tried again. During an outage, also one that comes and goes, *Search problems* notes a failure at most once in 30 seconds, with every problem still counted; a search term with letters such as *ä* is now left out of its messages also where they are capitals, such as *Ä*; and the requests tell Paperless and its proxies the real version of the app instead of 0.1.
- **The test of the connection says what went wrong, in your language.** Saving the settings answered every failure with the same English sentence, "Could not connect to Paperless. Check the URL, API token, and Nextcloud outbound connection policy.", and logged nothing, whether Paperless refused the token, the path was wrong, the host didn't resolve, Nextcloud refused a local address or didn't trust the certificate. Now the message names the cause and what to correct, such as a refused token, a wrong address, a blocked local address or an untrusted certificate, and the log of Nextcloud has the error, without the token. Every message of the settings is now translated, and the app speaks formal German to accounts set to *Deutsch (Förmlich: Sie)*, which saw it in English so far; its description on the *Apps* page no longer addresses them informally either.
- **The settings page shows clear, coloured feedback, keeps *Disconnect* off until something is configured, and works on phones.** In maintenance mode, as during every upgrade, or behind a proxy whose Nextcloud didn't answer, saving showed the whole HTML page of the error as its message, and a lost connection showed "Failed to fetch". Now each of them, and an expired session, gets one short sentence in your language. A failed first save no longer turns on *Disconnect*, which then wiped the URL you had typed, and after a save the URL field shows the URL as it was stored. Success and error messages have their colours in the light and the dark theme again, which Nextcloud's grey had covered, and an icon, so that they don't rest on colour alone. All fields are equally wide, each checkbox stands in front of its label, the problems of the search are readable cards on a phone, the icon of the section no longer turns pink when it is active, and screen readers read the hints of the token and of *Always include Paperless in global search* with their fields.
